task: 15b Temporal external Materials Project candidate acquisition; 16b provenance; 17 secondary subset
date_rule: created_at strictly after end of Matbench acquisition day; missing dates excluded
created_at_meaning: earliest completed task within current MaterialsDoc grouping; geometric exclusion still required, no guarantee this is date of first public release
structure: ComputedStructureEntry in selected GGA/GGA+U thermo document with corrected energy/atom equal to thermo energy_per_atom within1e-8; unique match required
label: formation_energy_per_atom from that same GGA_GGA+U ThermoDoc; eV/atom
id_normalization: numeric and alpha MP identifiers normalize to common integer using official AlphaID base26 identity; raw source alias retained
download_selection: all nondeprecated current core materials; date filter then historical ID exclusion; fetch GGA_GGA+U entries for every remaining ID, no target/error/stability selection
historical_rule: exclude any ID in existing development CSV/TSV/XYZ/EXTXYZ/JSONL or relevant JSON manifests/results; candidate geometry compared to all old Matbench and available historical development structures before final cohort certification

geometry_duplicate_policy.method: pymatgen StructureMatcher; primitive_cell=False, scale=False, attempt_supercell=False, ElementComparator; ltol=0.2, stol=0.3, angle_tol=5
geometry_duplicate_policy.development_duplicates: exclude candidate if matcher matches any excluded historical structure
geometry_duplicate_policy.within_candidate_duplicates: sort canonical ID; greedily retain first representative, exclude later matcher duplicates; regroup afterwards
geometry_duplicate_policy.if_zero_ID_candidates: not applicable; report no geometry audit performed

full_count_composition: 118 integers in Z order, pipe-delimited; never reduced formula for main grouping
group_selection: eligible50–100 all; >100 first100 ascending SHA256(canonical full-count key); <50 all with limitation; <20 report insufficiency and no automatic cross-database replacement
pairs: all unordered within-group pairs; ID stable ordering
secondary_metric: absolute MAE descriptive only: current MP correction/version differs from2019
R: norm(c-t)/norm(t), c=delta_prediction-delta_frozen, t=delta_truth-delta_frozen; nonpositive norm invalid

bootstrap.seed_statistic: mean of statistics from the three fixed seeds; same paired draws

non_degenerate: only after primary cohort lock, max(y)-min(y)>0.010 eV/atom strictly, secondary subset; no primary filtering
api_key: existing server private key file; credential never exported
